MA2071.title: Laboratory Experiments (Me)
MA2071.description:
The 10 experiments consist of:

E2.1	Effects of cutting parameters on surface roughness of turned parts 
E2.2 	Study of fan performance using dimensional analysis
E2.3 	Energy balance in a compressor
E2.4 	Dimensional measurement of components
E2.5 	Two-dimensional strain measurement
E2.6 	Frictional losses in pipes and fittings 
E2.7 	Refrigeration cycle experiment 
E2.8 	Non-destructive testing 
E2.9 	Balancing of rotating masses 
E2.10	Torsion of cylindrical shafts

For the 10 experiments, each student will submit nine log-sheets (on the same day) and one Technical Report (within 1 week).
